scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline picture-book painting for the Japanese graded-reading story “Cinderella”
Primary request: depict the opening situation: Cinderella works in the house in her worn ash-dusted clothes, quietly alone for a moment.
Scene/backdrop: a modest old European cottage kitchen, with a simple hearth and a small view of the garden tree through an open doorway; keep the room quiet and uncluttered.
Subject: Cinderella is a young woman with warm brown hair tied in a low bun, wearing the story-cover character’s simple russet dress and cream apron, now dusty with a little hearth ash. She kneels beside the hearth with a small hand broom, pausing with a thoughtful, lonely but calm expression. Use the cover only to guide her hair, russet-and-ivory clothing and palette; make this scene much simpler than the cover.
Style/medium: gentle children’s storybook painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, soft contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background.
Composition/framing: landscape around 12:7; medium-wide view with Cinderella clearly readable at small inline size, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft late-afternoon light, tender and resilient, not bleak.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted russet and ochre, quiet sage, and soft indigo shadows.
Constraints: original character design; illustrate only the opening paragraph, before the invitation or fairy appears.
Avoid: other people, magic, carriage, glass slippers, legible text, lettering, title, border, frame, watermark, logo, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture, dramatic misery.
